Name: Rock, Paper, Lazers
Overview:
Who says paper always wins? When was the last time you stopped a flying rock with a piece of paper?!

It's time you witnessed the true power, of the almighty ROCK!! Now equipped with lazers, rockets and other assorted weaponry. Not to mention the teleportation do-hickey's...

So now it's time to fight for your survival in the ultimate game of Rock, Paper, Lazers!!
